discovery_lineage_rule: For each frozen pair, survey_a is discovery lineage and survey_b is held out for later independent replay. Stage1 does not inspect survey_b depth.
common_support_rule: Candidate centers are a 250m local Cartesian grid retained only where FNV swath geometry from both surveys intersects the 250m center cell.

deterministic_patch_cap.selection: geometry-only: sort patch points by polar angle then radial distance around candidate and take evenly spaced indices across that ordering

metric_implementation.angular: normalized Fourier amplitudes m=2..6 of plane residuals
metric_implementation.linearity: 2D covariance eigenvalue anisotropy of high-absolute-residual points above patch median absolute residual
metric_implementation.terrace_step: maximum adjacent radial-annulus median-depth jump divided by plane residual MAD
metric_implementation.topologic: counts/persistence of local radial-profile extrema after 50m radial binning; descriptive approximation only
metric_implementation.generic: robust standardized max/mean score across implemented metric families, ranked empirically within region
